faqA: No. Patron does not increase combat stats or daily limits. It adds cosmetics and conveniences, including automatic recruiting within the normal daily limit and Discord alerts. You cannot buy units, gold or turns.

terms.title: Patronage terms
terms.intro: You buy Patron memberships, gift codes and alliance sponsorships from AIOXperts IT Solutions LLC, a Delaware limited liability company that operates OpenThrone. These terms cover those purchases.

eligibility.title: Who can buy
eligibility.body: You must be at least 18 and an adult where you live to make a purchase. If you are younger, a parent or legal guardian must make the purchase and agree to these terms. Purchases are available to people who live in the United States. You must have permission to use the payment method.

purchase.title: What you are paying for
purchase.body: Patronage supports OpenThrone. It gives the perks listed on the Patronage page: a badge, Discord alerts, and conveniences such as automatic recruiting within the normal daily limit. It never increases combat stats or daily limits, and you cannot buy units, gold or turns. Your membership gives you access to these features for its stated duration. Perks and in-game items cannot be exchanged for cash; this does not affect refunds required by law. We may update perks to keep the game secure, meet legal requirements or improve it. We will tell you in advance about changes that materially reduce paid benefits.

billing.title: Prices, renewal and cancellation
billing.body: Prices are in US dollars. Any applicable tax is added at checkout and shown before you pay. Monthly Patron renews automatically at the price you accepted at checkout until you cancel. Current prices are shown on the Patronage page. Price changes apply only to new purchases; existing subscribers keep their agreed price. To stop the next renewal, open your Patronage page, select Manage billing, and cancel your subscription; do this before the renewal date. You keep the access you already paid for. Cancelling does not by itself request a refund. If a renewal payment fails, Stripe may retry it, and you keep access for 7 days after the first failed attempt. The era pass gives 100 days of Patron access and continues across era resets. Gift codes add 30, 90 or 360 days when redeemed. Pass and gift time extends your existing access but does not pause monthly charges, and starting a subscription charges you at once even if you already have access. The era pass, gift codes and alliance sponsorships are one-time purchases and do not renew.

gifts.title: Gift codes
gifts.body: You can redeem each gift code once. A paid gift code stays valid for at least 5 years from purchase, and never expires where state law requires that. Anyone with the code can redeem it, so share it carefully. Gift codes cannot be exchanged for cash, except where the law requires.

sponsorship.title: Alliance sponsorships
sponsorship.body: A sponsorship is a one-time payment to OpenThrone, not to the alliance or its leader. Each $4.99 credited to the pool adds 30 days of alliance premium; smaller remainders stay in the pool. Your sponsorship stays with the alliance if you leave it.

accounts.title: Bans, closures and deletion
accounts.body: If your account is banned or closed, we stop future subscription renewals, and you may lose access to the game and its perks when the restriction starts. Deleting your account ends your access and cancels your subscription. These actions do not automatically issue a refund; your rights to refunds under the law still apply.

disputes.title: Payment disputes
disputes.body: If you dispute a payment with your bank, we may suspend the access bought with that payment while the dispute is decided. If the payment is upheld, we restore the remaining access it bought. If the payment is reversed, that access ends. This does not limit your right to dispute a payment.

privacy.title: Payment data
privacy.body: Stripe processes your payment. We do not store your full card number or security code. We keep payment identifiers, amounts, currency, status and dates, and related billing records: membership details, gift purchases and redemptions, refunds, disputes, your billing country and state, the terms you agreed to at checkout, and the accounts or alliances involved. Our Privacy Policy explains how we use and keep these records; Stripe has its own privacy policy.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: Delaware law governs these terms. This does not take away protections that the law where you live gives you. Disputes may be brought in the courts of Delaware, subject to any right you have to use courts elsewhere.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For questions about a payment, a refund or these terms, email privacy@openthrone.dev. You do not need a Discord account. Never post card details in public channels.

refunds.title: Refund policy
refunds.intro: How refunds work for Patron memberships, gift codes and alliance sponsorships.

request.title: Asking for a refund
request.body: Email privacy@openthrone.dev with your kingdom name and the payment date. We refund confirmed duplicate charges and purchases whose promised perks were not supplied. For other refunds, contact us within 14 days of payment. This deadline does not limit your rights under consumer law.

how.title: How refunds work
how.body: Refunds go back to the original payment method through Stripe and usually arrive within 5 to 10 business days. A full refund removes the remaining access, or the unused gift code, bought with that payment; access from other purchases is not affected. A partial refund does not change your access. A refund does not cancel a monthly subscription unless we confirm that separately.

cancel.title: Cancelling
cancel.body: Cancelling stops future renewals and normally leaves your paid access available until it ends. It does not automatically refund an earlier payment. You can still ask for a refund or use your rights under consumer law.

gifts.title: Gift codes and sponsorships
gifts.body: You can get a refund for an unredeemed gift code if you ask within 14 days of purchase. We normally do not offer change-of-mind refunds for redeemed codes or for sponsorships already turned into premium time. These limits do not affect refunds required by law.
